joint: 12 SK20 supports: 4 Y on the base, 4 X on the wall, 4 Z on the carriage plate
fastener: M6 x 40 hex bolt, washer, pronged T-nut from the far face

joint: 4 Y blocks under the deck, from above
fastener: M5 x 30 (or M6, as the block is tapped) into the block

joint: 4 X blocks on the carriage plate's back, from its front face
fastener: M5 x 30 (or M6) into the block

joint: 4 Z blocks on the support plate's back, from its front face; the lower pair countersunk, before the tool plate goes on
fastener: M5 x 30 (or M6) into the block

joint: Router clamp
fastener: M6 x 100 knob bolt, hex nut in the pocket

joint: Pilot clamp
fastener: M4 x 90 knob bolt, hex nut in the pocket

joint: Stop screw
fastener: M8 x 90 with a knob, through an M8 T-nut set into the top of the ear, an M8 jam nut above the ear

joint: Blank's slotted fence
fastener: M5 x 25 bolt and washer into a T-nut set into the platform from below, before the platform is screwed down

joint: Balancer bracket leg to the carriage plate
fastener: M6 x 40 bolt and T-nut

joint: Cable eye on the ear
fastener: M4 screw eye

joint: Balancer hook in the arm
fastener: an 8 mm S-hook or shackle

joint: Wall onto the deck's back edge, from below through the deck
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, every 100 mm, glued

joint: Gussets to the deck and the wall
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, 3 each way, glued

joint: Tool plate's two plies laminated
fastener: no. 8 x 32 wood screw, countersunk from below, clear of the bores

joint: Tool plate to the support plate, from behind
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, glued

joint: Webs to the support plate from behind and down into the tool plate
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, 2 each way, glued

joint: Stop ear to the support plate, from behind
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, glued

joint: Balancer bracket arm to its leg
fastener: no. 8 x 50 wood screw, glued

joint: Battens under the base
fastener: no. 8 x 32 wood screw from above, countersunk, every 150 mm, glued

joint: Platforms to the base, countersunk flush
fastener: no. 8 x 32 wood screw

joint: Pattern plate's L fence
fastener: no. 6 x 25 wood screw
